features.title: RSS feed per locale (Phase 8)
features.reason: RSS 2.0 feeds at /en/feed.xml and /id/feed.xml from a force-static Route Handler (app/[locale]/feed.xml/route.ts): published articles of the locale, newest first, summary-only (frontmatter description), tags as categories, lastBuildDate from newest updatedAt (deterministic). features.title: Fix O4 gyro swap article filenames to match slugs
features.reason: Articles were merged with en- and id- filename prefixes, causing getArticleByRoute to fail on fast path and render 404 pages during SSG build. Files renamed to match slugs; merged in PR #56.

features.title: Fix mobile horizontal overflow on article pages + dependency/security bumps
features.reason: At 390px, article pages scrolled sideways and cut text off: the single-column grid had no explicit track (min-content grew with long code/URLs), raw reference URLs did not wrap, and the sidebar Reveal x-offset added 10px. Fixed with grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)], overflow-wrap:anywhere on prose links, overflow-x-clip on the article section. Also bumped next 16.3.3->16.4.3 (clears GHSA-2464-fhr4-w9xw, GHSA-p3m5-59mp-jv5r, GHSA-673q-mjm6-r5xr), wrangler, sharp, undici, brace-expansion, source-map-js, zod (npm audit: 0 vulnerabilities). Replaces Dependabot PRs #44-#47, #49.
features.verification: ./init.sh exit 0 (lint 0 errors, 169 pages, smoke OK, 82/82 id pages lang=id). Playwright: 34 article pages x 390px/1440px, scrollWidth <= viewport on all 68 (before: 30+ overflowed at 390px, up to 736px). Sticky aside still pins at top-24 on 1440px.

features.title: Drone portfolio interactive Flight Map

Leaflet 1.9.4 lazy client component, coordinates/flightType in portfolio frontmatter (rounded to 2 decimals), 5 located items from Air 3S EXIF/SRT + IG captions, portfolio images on R2 without metadata. Open content (not code): coordinates for anyer-coastal, batang-rest-area, commercial-real-estate (candidate held for privacy), FPV items.
